sample_text: ការព្រមាន៖ ឧបករណ៍របស់អ្នកមានហានិភ័យខ្ពស់។ ទាញយក Security Update ពី https://device-patch.example ឥឡូវនេះ។

title: Lottery Tax Before Release
description: A lottery notification requires tax or handling payment before releasing an unexpected prize.
sample_text: អ្នកឈ្នះឆ្នោត ១០,០០០ ដុល្លារ។ បង់ពន្ធ និងថ្លៃដឹកជញ្ជូន ២៥០ ដុល្លារមុន ដើម្បីទទួលរង្វាន់។

title: Instant Loan Processing Fee
description: A lender guarantees approval and asks for a processing or insurance fee before disbursement.
sample_text: ឥណទាន ៥,០០០ ដុល្លាររបស់អ្នកបានអនុម័តដោយមិនបាច់ពិនិត្យឥណទាន។ បង់ថ្លៃដំណើរការ ១០០ ដុល្លារមុន។
indicators: guaranteed approval|advance fee|no credit check|urgent disbursement

title: Identity Verification Document Harvesting
description: A fake verification process requests an ID photo, selfie, bank details, and password.
sample_text: ដើម្បីធ្វើ KYC សូមផ្ញើរូបអត្តសញ្ញាណប័ណ្ណទាំងសងខាង រូប Selfie លេខគណនី និងពាក្យសម្ងាត់ក្នុង Chat នេះ។
indicators: ID document request|selfie request|bank details|password request

title: Disaster Relief Donation Impersonation
description: A fake charity uses a recent disaster and urgency to solicit transfers to a personal account.
sample_text: ជួយគ្រួសាររងគ្រោះជាបន្ទាន់។ សូមបរិច្ចាគទៅគណនីផ្ទាល់ខ្លួននេះក្នុងថ្ងៃនេះ ព្រោះយើងត្រូវទិញអាហារភ្លាមៗ។

title: Romanized Khmer Work From Home Fee

sample_text: Tver kar tam phone ban 80 dollar mouy thngai. Bong fee chol team 20 dollar mun sen hai start ban phleam.

title: Romanized Product Rating Recharge
description: A Romanized Khmer task offer asks the worker to recharge an account before withdrawing commission.
sample_text: Rate product 5 dong ban commission. Som recharge 50 USDT dermbei unlock task ning withdraw profit.

title: Mixed Khmer Marketplace Deposit
description: A mixed-language seller demands a KHQR reservation payment before inspection.
sample_text: Laptop ថ្មី special price $280 only today. ផ្ញើ deposit $50 តាម KHQR now ដើម្បី reserve មុនអ្នកផ្សេង។
indicators: price too low|KHQR deposit|mixed-language pressure|no inspection

title: Mixed Khmer Bank OTP Request
description: A mixed Khmer-English bank alert asks for login details and an OTP through an external site.
sample_text: Bank security alert: គណនីអ្នកមាន unusual login. Verify នៅ https://account-check.example ហើយបញ្ចូល password និង OTP។

title: Romanized Instant Loan Commission
description: A Romanized Khmer loan message requires a commission before releasing approved funds.
sample_text: Loan bong approve 3000 dollar hai. Som transfer commission 70 dollar mun sen teub money release today.

title: Mixed Khmer VIP Crypto Signal
description: A mixed-language Telegram pitch guarantees returns from a VIP cryptocurrency group.
sample_text: Join VIP Telegram ឥឡូវនេះ។ Invest 100 USDT, guaranteed profit 400 USDT tomorrow, no risk.

title: Romanized Romance Emergency
description: A Romanized Khmer romantic contact requests emergency money and promises quick repayment.
sample_text: Oun srolanh bong nas. Pel nih mae oun chheu nov hospital; som send 250 dollar, oun song vinh tomorrow.

title: Mixed Khmer Prize Claim Fee
description: A mixed-language prize message demands a claim fee and identity details.
sample_text: Congratulations! អ្នកឈ្នះ cash prize $5,000. Pay claim fee $100 និង send ID photo before midnight.

title: Mixed Khmer Account Protection Service
description: A fake cybersecurity service claims a social account is under attack and requests money and admin access.
sample_text: Your page is under attack! បង់ $40 ហើយ add account នេះជា Admin ដើម្បី protection ភ្លាមៗ។
indicators: fake protection service|admin access|advance payment|fear tactic

title: Romanized Supplier Bank Change
description: A Romanized Khmer message impersonates a supplier and changes payment instructions.
sample_text: Invoice thmei attach. Account bank chas mean problem; som transfer tov account thmei nih today and keep confidential.
indicators: supplier impersonation|bank detail change|invoice pressure|secrecy request

title: Mixed Khmer CEO Gift Card Request
description: An executive impersonator asks an employee to buy gift cards secretly and send the codes.
sample_text: ខ្ញុំកំពុង meeting. Please buy 10 gift cards now and send photos of codes to me. កុំប្រាប់អ្នកផ្សេង។

title: Romanized Payroll Account Change
description: A fake employee asks payroll to redirect salary to a new account before payday.
sample_text: Som update salary account robos khnhom tov account thmei nih mun payroll today. Khnhom min ach call verify ban te.

title: Mixed Khmer Parking QR Payment
description: A fake parking notice uses a QR code to collect card data or payment.
sample_text: Parking fine overdue. ស្កេន QR នេះ និង enter card details ដើម្បី avoid extra penalty today.

title: Romanized Delivery Reschedule
description: A Romanized Khmer courier text asks the recipient to update an address and pay through a link.
sample_text: Delivery khos address. Som click https://ship-update.example, update info ning pay fee touch mun package return.

title: Mixed Khmer Social Recovery Code
description: A fake social-platform helper asks for a recovery code sent to the victim.
sample_text: Facebook support: គណនីអ្នកនឹង disabled. Send recovery code ដែលទើបទទួលបានមក chat នេះឥឡូវ។

title: Mixed Khmer Fake Bank App
description: A bank impersonator links to an unofficial app package and requests login after installation.
sample_text: Update Mobile Banking ថ្មី។ Download app from https://secure-app.example, install ហើយ login ដើម្បី activate.

title: Romanized Money Transfer Agent
description: A Romanized Khmer job pitch offers commission for moving money through a personal account.
sample_text: Job easy: receive money chol account bong, transfer tov wallet nih, keep 8 percent commission every day.
indicators: Romanized Khmer|receive and forward funds|personal account|commission

title: Mixed Khmer Scam Recovery Fee
description: A supposed investigator promises to recover a prior scam loss after an upfront fee.
sample_text: យើង found money ដែលអ្នកបានបាត់ពី scam មុន។ Pay recovery fee $75 first ហើយយើង refund ក្នុង 24 hours.
indicators: prior victim targeting|recovery promise|upfront fee|guaranteed refund

title: Romanized Sextortion Payment Threat
description: A blackmailer threatens to share intimate material unless paid immediately.
sample_text: Khnhom mean video private robos anak. Send 500 USDT within 2 hours, kom block, min doch nih khnhom send tov family.

title: CEO Confidential Wire Request
description: An attacker impersonates a chief executive and orders an urgent confidential wire transfer.
sample_text: I am in a board meeting and cannot speak. Wire $38,500 to the attached beneficiary today and keep this confidential.

title: Vendor Invoice Bank Detail Change
description: A lookalike supplier email redirects a legitimate invoice payment to a new bank account.
sample_text: Our banking details changed. Please pay invoice 7841 to the replacement account in the attachment before close of business.
indicators: supplier impersonation|bank detail change|lookalike sender|invoice urgency

title: Home Purchase Wire Diversion
description: A fraudster impersonates a property professional and sends altered closing wire instructions.
sample_text: Updated closing instructions: send the house deposit to this new escrow account today. Do not use the earlier details.
indicators: real-estate transaction|changed wire instructions|time pressure|email impersonation

title: Executive Gift Card Purchase
description: A spoofed manager requests gift cards and asks the employee to reveal their redemption codes.
sample_text: I need twelve gift cards for client awards. Buy them now and email clear photos of every code; I will reimburse you.

title: Employee Payroll Diversion
description: An attacker posing as an employee asks payroll to reroute salary to a new account.
sample_text: Please update my direct-deposit account before today's payroll run. I am traveling and cannot complete phone verification.
indicators: employee impersonation|payroll change|new bank account|verification avoidance

title: Fake Attorney Settlement Transfer
description: A compromised legal email account supplies fraudulent settlement payment instructions.
sample_text: The settlement account has changed. Transfer the funds using the attached instructions by noon to avoid delaying the case.

title: Supplier Duplicate Invoice Refund
description: A fraudster claims an invoice was paid twice and requests a refund to an unrelated account.
sample_text: Your team paid invoice 442 twice. Refund the duplicate amount today to our alternate account shown below.

title: Fake Cloud Document Login
description: A business phishing email links to a counterfeit cloud document sign-in page.
sample_text: A confidential contract has been shared with you. Sign in with your work email at https://document-view.example before access expires.
indicators: shared document lure|credential harvesting|work email request|expiring access

title: IT Helpdesk Password Reset
description: An attacker impersonates internal IT and asks the employee to enter credentials on an external page.
sample_text: IT notice: your company password expires in 20 minutes. Keep access by signing in at https://helpdesk-reset.example.

title: Fake Business Software Renewal
description: A forged renewal notice pressures a company to pay for a service it did not order.
sample_text: Final renewal notice: your security license ends today. Pay the attached invoice immediately to prevent system shutdown.

title: Bank Account Locked SMS
description: A text impersonating a bank claims an account is locked and links to a credential-harvesting page.
sample_text: Security alert: your bank account is locked after an unusual login. Restore access now at https://bank-unlock.example.

title: Unauthorized Card Charge Alert
description: A fake fraud alert asks the recipient to sign in through a link to dispute a card transaction.
sample_text: Did you approve a $786 card purchase? If not, cancel it immediately at https://card-dispute.example.

title: Tax Refund Credential Trap
description: A fake tax refund notice collects identity and payment-card details through a link.
sample_text: You qualify for a $640 tax refund. Submit your identity and card details at https://refund-claim.example within 48 hours.

title: Voucher Survey Phishing
description: A message promises a shopping voucher for completing a short survey that ends with a card request.
sample_text: Complete this two-minute survey and receive a $200 shopping voucher. Pay only $1 delivery at https://voucher-survey.example.
indicators: voucher lure|survey pretext|small card charge|suspicious link

title: MFA Push Fatigue Call
description: An attacker floods the victim with login approvals and then calls pretending to resolve the issue.
sample_text: This is the security desk. To stop the repeated login prompts, approve the next notification and tell me the number shown.
indicators: repeated MFA prompts|support impersonation|approval request|verification number

title: Fake QR Parking Meter
description: A sticker covers a legitimate parking QR code and sends users to a counterfeit payment page.
sample_text: Parking payment required. Scan this QR code, enter your card details, and pay now to avoid a citation.
indicators: tampered QR code|parking payment|card data request|penalty pressure

title: QR Cryptocurrency Giveaway
description: A social post promises doubled cryptocurrency after payment through a QR code.
sample_text: Limited crypto giveaway: scan the QR code and send 0.02 BTC. We will return 0.04 BTC within minutes.

title: Unpaid Toll Text
description: A text claims a toll balance is overdue and threatens penalties through a payment link.
sample_text: Final notice: you owe $6.40 in unpaid road tolls. Pay at https://toll-settle.example today to avoid a $50 penalty.
indicators: unpaid toll claim|penalty threat|small payment|suspicious link

title: Package Address Update
description: A fake postal message asks for address and card details to reschedule delivery.
sample_text: We could not deliver your parcel because the address is incomplete. Update it and pay $0.45 at https://parcel-route.example.

title: Brushing Package QR Trap
description: An unexpected package contains a QR code promising sender details but leading to a malicious site.
sample_text: Not sure who sent this gift? Scan the enclosed QR code to identify the sender and claim your bonus item.
indicators: unexpected package|QR code lure|unknown sender|bonus promise

title: Fake Antivirus Popup
description: A browser popup claims the device is infected and urges the user to call a fake support number.
sample_text: Critical virus alert! Your files and banking data are at risk. Call support immediately and do not close this window.
indicators: fake virus warning|support phone number|fear tactic|browser popup

title: Remote Refund Overpayment
description: A fake support agent uses remote access and a fabricated refund error to demand repayment.
sample_text: We refunded $5,000 instead of $500. Keep remote access open and return the difference by cryptocurrency today.

title: Subscription Renewal Callback
description: A fake subscription invoice directs the recipient to call a number where remote access is requested.
sample_text: Your computer protection plan renewed for $399. If this was not you, call the cancellation desk immediately for a refund.
indicators: unexpected renewal|callback number|refund lure|remote access risk

title: Fake Operating System Update
description: A message impersonates a software vendor and links to a malicious update installer.
sample_text: Your operating system is missing a critical patch. Download and run the update from https://urgent-patch.example now.

title: Government Secure Account Transfer
description: An official impersonator says the victim's money is unsafe and must be moved to a protected account.
sample_text: This is a federal investigator. Your bank account is linked to a crime. Transfer your funds to our secure account today.
indicators: government impersonation|account threat|safe account claim|urgent transfer

title: Cash Courier Protection Scam
description: A fake official instructs the victim to withdraw cash or gold for collection by a courier.
sample_text: Withdraw your savings in cash to protect it from hackers. An authorized courier will collect the sealed package this afternoon.

title: Utility Gift Card Demand
description: A utility impersonator threatens shutoff and demands payment using gift cards.
sample_text: Your electricity will be disconnected in one hour. Buy two gift cards and read the numbers to our billing agent.

title: Grandchild Legal Emergency
description: A caller impersonates a relative and asks for secret bail or legal payment.
sample_text: Grandma, I was arrested after an accident. Please send bail money to my lawyer now and do not tell my parents.

title: Fake Immigration Consultant
description: An unqualified consultant guarantees immigration approval in exchange for immediate fees and documents.
sample_text: Your visa is guaranteed if you pay our express fee today. Send your passport scan and payment through this chat.

title: Scholarship Processing Fee
description: A student is told they won financial aid but must pay a processing charge first.
sample_text: You were selected for a $12,000 scholarship. Pay the $95 processing fee within 24 hours to reserve your award.

title: Disaster Charity Crypto Appeal
description: A fraudulent relief appeal solicits cryptocurrency without verifiable charity information.
sample_text: Families urgently need help after the flood. Donate cryptocurrency to this wallet now; no other payment method is available.

title: Lottery Shipping and Tax Fee
description: A fake lottery winner notice requires multiple fees before the prize can supposedly be delivered.
sample_text: You won $750,000 in an international lottery. Pay the tax and courier fee before your certified check can be released.

title: Advance Fee Personal Loan
description: A lender promises approval regardless of credit but requires insurance or processing money upfront.
sample_text: You are approved for a $20,000 loan with no credit check. Send the $350 insurance fee before funds are released.
indicators: guaranteed loan|no credit check|advance insurance fee|release promise

title: Fake Check Mystery Shopper
description: A fake employer sends an overvalued check and tells the recruit to buy gift cards and report the codes.
sample_text: Deposit this $2,400 check, keep $400 as your shopper fee, and use the balance to buy gift cards for evaluation.
indicators: fake check|mystery shopper job|gift card purchase|overpayment

title: Online Buyer Overpayment
description: A buyer deliberately sends a fake check for too much and asks the seller to return the difference.
sample_text: I accidentally sent $1,800 for the $800 item. Deposit the check and wire the extra $1,000 to my shipping agent.

title: Rental Deposit Before Viewing
description: A fake landlord copies a listing and asks for an application fee and deposit before a viewing.
sample_text: The apartment is available below market price. Send the application fee and security deposit before I mail the keys.
indicators: below-market rent|deposit before viewing|remote landlord|key mailing

title: Recovery Agent Upfront Retainer
description: A prior scam victim is contacted by someone promising recovery for an upfront retainer.
sample_text: We located the money you lost to the investment platform. Pay our $300 retainer and we guarantee recovery within a week.
indicators: prior victim targeting|guaranteed recovery|upfront retainer|unsolicited contact

title: Fake Government Refund Officer
description: A fraudster claims to be a government refund official and asks for bank details and an administrative fee.
sample_text: Your scam reimbursement is approved. Send your bank account number and pay the administrative charge to receive it.
indicators: government impersonation|refund promise|bank information request|advance fee

title: Romance Customs Emergency
description: An online romantic partner claims a valuable package is held and asks the victim to pay customs charges.
sample_text: I sent you gifts and documents for our future, but customs is holding the package. Please pay the release fee for me today.
indicators: online relationship|gift package story|customs fee|urgent money request

title: Romance Money Mule Request
description: A romantic contact asks the victim to receive funds and forward them to another person.
sample_text: My business account is frozen. Let my client send $8,000 to your account, then transfer it to my partner and keep $500.
indicators: romantic trust|receive and forward funds|commission offer|bank account use

title: Financial Sextortion Demand
description: A blackmailer threatens to distribute intimate material unless paid in cryptocurrency.
sample_text: I saved your private images and your contact list. Send 700 USDT within three hours or I will share everything.

title: Sextortion Recovery Service
description: A supposed removal service targets a sextortion victim and demands payment without providing legitimate help.
sample_text: We can erase the images and identify the blackmailer. Pay our emergency removal fee now before the content spreads.

title: Address Poisoning Token Scam
description: A counterfeit crypto token or similar wallet address is used to trick a victim into transferring assets.
sample_text: Your token claim is ready. Copy the recent wallet address shown in your history and send funds there to unlock it.
indicators: wallet address mimicry|token impersonation|unlock fee|crypto transfer

title: Fake Trading Withdrawal Penalty
description: A fraudulent platform shows large returns but demands repeated payments to unlock withdrawals.
sample_text: Your trading profit is $24,600. Deposit $2,000 for verification today or your account and earnings will be frozen.
indicators: fake platform profits|withdrawal blocked|verification deposit|account threat

title: Celebrity Crypto Giveaway
description: An impersonated celebrity account promises to multiply cryptocurrency sent by followers.
sample_text: Official celebration giveaway: send any amount of cryptocurrency to the posted wallet and receive triple back instantly.
